articles.summary: Strong execution, improving solid waste landfill volumes and further strength in commodity-related revenues drive outsized results and another increase to full year outlook Revenue of $2.638 billion, exceeding expectations Net income of $359.2 million, and adjusted EBITDA * of $895.8 million, or 34.0% of revenue, above expectations Net income and adjusted net income * of $1.43 and $1.58 per share, respectively Year to date closed acquisitions of approximately $130 million in annualized revenues
articles.title: Waste Connections Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Outlook

articles.summary: Waste Connections, Inc. (TSX/NYSE: WCN) ("Waste Connections" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on the Company's common shares and approved a 10.0% increase in the dividend. The regular quarterly cash dividend, which increases to $0.385 U.S. per common share of the Company from $0.350 U.S. per common share of the Company, will be paid on November 19, 2026 to shareholders of record on the close of business on November 5, 2026. The Board intends to review the quarterly dividend each October, with a long-term objective of increasing the amount of the dividend. Shareholders of Waste Connections whose common shares are held by a bank or broker that participates in U.S. depositary DTC will receive payment of their dividends in U.S. dollars. Shareholders of Waste Connections whose common shares are held by a bank or broker that participates in Canadian depositary CDS will receive payment of their dividends in Canadian
articles.title: Waste Connections Announces 10.0% Increase in Quarterly Dividend
